title: MediaOCD Announces Deal to Sell Select Aniplex of America Anime on Blu-ray Disc
content:
MediaOCD announced on Wednesday a sales agreement with Aniplex of America to sell select anime on Blu-ray Disc on the MediaOCD online store. Initial Aniplex of America titles available on MediaOCD 's website are the Gurren Lagann television series and films, and the two seasons of the Mashle: Magic and Muscles anime.

The Gurren Lagann Complete Blu-ray Disc Box includes the television series' 27 episodes and the Gurren Lagann the Movie -Childhood's End- , and Gurren Lagann the Movie -The Lights in the Sky Are Stars- films. The box set also includes the special Blu-ray Disc version of the anime's sixth episode "There Are Some Things I Just Have to See!!" and the broadcast version "Sit In the Hot Tub 'Til You're Sick!"

The Gurren Lagann the Movie 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray Disc features the two films remastered in 4K to celebrate the films' 15th anniversary in 2023. The release includes the English dub of both films, which debuted during the films' revival screenings in North America in 2024.

The 27-episode Gurren Lagann television anime series aired in 2007, and it spawned two anime films, two OVAs, several manga adaptations and spinoffs, and three stage plays.

Gurren Lagann the Movie –Childhood's End-– originally opened in September 2008, and Gurren Lagann the Movie – The Lights in the Sky Are Stars– opened in April 2009.

The Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 1 Complete Blu-ray Disc Box and the Mashle: Magic and Muscles The Divine Visionary Candidate Exam Arc Complete Blu-ray Disc Box both include the following bonus content and materials: mini-character stickers, special booklet, original soundtrack CD, and creditless opening and ending videos. The season 1 box also includes a U.S. Blu-ray exclusive coaster.

The anime's first season debuted in April 2023, followed by the second season January 2024. The anime's third season will debut in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Naruto Readies for Big Anime Reveal With New Teaser – Watch
content:
Naruto has been gearing up for a major return from the anime franchise, and it’s setting up for a big reveal later this weekend with the stars of the series in tow. Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto franchise is now in the midst of a massive comeback as not only is there a new live-action feature film adaptation in the works , but there’s also plans to bring the anime back with a new project. And we’ll be seeing the first full look at the new release soon enough with a big reveal planned.

Naruto took fans by surprise earlier this Summer when it was first announced that the franchise was going to be bringing something big to New York Comic Con 2026 this month. The hype for the new anime really took off, however, when it was then announced that the franchise would be sharing the first real look at the anime’s future. Now the voice stars behind it have shared a special new teaser video hyping up their upcoming appearance at the event this coming weekend. You can check it out below.

Naruto Stars Hype Anime’s NYCC 2026 Reveals

Taking place on Saturday, October 10th at 5PM ET, “NARUTO: What’s Next?” is a special new panel for the franchise where they will reveal the first look at the future of the series. Viz Media confirmed that Studio Pierrot executive producer Tominaga Yoshihiko, Naruto Uzumaki voice star Junko Takeuchi, and Sasuke Uchiha voice star Noriaki Sugiyama will be in attendance. Not only that, but the franchise is going all out for the event with a special worldwide livestream planned so that even fans who won’t be physically attending the events can see the new reveals as they hit.

As for what this reveal will be, it’s going to be the first real look at the Naruto anime revival that has been on an indefinite hiatus for the last three years. First announced to be in the works following the 20th anniversary of the Naruto franchise, this new revival was touted to be a four episode miniseries featuring the earliest days of Team 7 from the original Naruto anime incarnation. First announced to be in development for a release in 2023 before it was put on an indefinite hiatus , it’s finally time to see what kind of shape it’s taken thus far.

What’s Next for Naruto?

It was also teased during this event that Naruto would be revealing a new animated film, but it’s yet to be known whether or not the film and revival are referring to the same project . There could be something else revealed for the anime entirely during this upcoming event, and that makes it all the more interesting for the New York Comic Con 2026 panel. Not only that, but there could be any sorts of other announcements that have even yet to be teased about the future of the franchise.

Naruto has been dormant for the past three years following Boruto: Naruto Next Generations also going on hiatus with its own anime release , so any forward momentum for the anime will be very much appreciated at this time. What are you hoping to see from Naruto ‘s anime revealed during New York Comic Con 2026? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Trailer Hypes Crunchyroll Streaming Release – Watch Now
content:
Dragon Ball Super is only a few days away from the anime’s return with a new remake series , and Crunchyroll is gearing up for the remake’s streaming release with a new trailer. Dragon Ball Super ‘s TV anime first made its debut over a decade ago at this point, and it might be hard to believe that the series is just as strong these days as it was back then. Now it’s set to reach a whole new level as the anime is going to get an enhanced remake airing this Fall.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an enhanced version of the original TV anime series that will be offering new visuals, sound effects, music and more. It’s going to be taking on the TV series from the very beginning with an updated version of the Battle of Gods arc, and Crunchyroll is set to stream the series alongside its debut in Japan on October 11th. You can check out the trailer for Crunchyroll’s upcoming release of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus below.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Readies for Crunchyroll Streaming Release

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be making its debut on October 11th in Japan, and will be streaming its new episodes with Crunchyroll for fans in the United States, Canada, Latin America including Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia and Europe that same day. This won’t be the only platform that the new remake will be available on, however, as Netflix has announced that they will also begin streaming the new remake series beginning on October 17th. So there’s multiple options for fans to check it all out.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be directed by Tadayoshi Yamamuro for Toei Animation with Matsuto Seya providing the composition and direction arrangement, Eichi Nishimura serving as editor, Yosuke Motoki serving as compositing director, and Norihito Sumitomo composing the music. There will also be a new set of opening and ending themes with a new opening titled “ONOGAMI” as performed by MEGATERA・ZERO, and a new ending titled “Kan Peki No Peki” as performed by VK Blanka. So we’ll see how much has been changed from the original TV series soon enough.

What’s New for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus will be going back to the beginning with new takes on the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs, and has been touted to include “extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story.” But it’s yet to be revealed how long this new remake series is going to run for, nor whether or not the other arcs will eventually be remade .

Dragon Ball Super kicking off its new remake series is only the first of the new anime projects we’ll see coming our way in the near future. Dragon Ball Super has also announced it’s working on a brand new anime series adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc from the manga. Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol has yet to announce a concrete release date or window as of this time , but are you excited to kick off Dragon Ball Super’s return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Magical Girl Recruiter Puicho!, Bitter Knight in My Sweet Café, 3 More Manga
content:
Manga UP! Global added the following manga over the past two weeks:

But among the customers who gather for their love of cute things, there's a peculiar one who only orders black coffee every morning: Arthur Villand, the frightening and ruthless knight commander. And the reason he comes to the cafe is...?! A bittersweet tale of love between an airheaded heroine and a strait-laced but doting knight, is served!

All college student Sena Minazuki wants is a modest, ordinary life. But one night, he returns home to find that his once-doting older sister, Ran, has undergone a drastic change—and suddenly attacks him with deadly intent. Just as she's about to overwhelm him, a mysterious armed organization storms in and opens fire on the rampaging Ran. Sena soon learns that she was suffering from "Vampxia"—a government-classified disease that turns ordinary humans into bloodthirsty monsters with terrifying strength. Unfortunately, the truth arrives a little too late... because Sena has already begun to manifest symptoms himself!

title: Eva Marie Saint, Superman Returns & Legend of Korra Actress, Dead at 102
content:
Eva Marie Saint, the iconic actress from Hollywood’s golden era, has passed away. Reps for the actress confirmed to Deadline that she died at her home in Los Angeles, “surrounded by family and loved ones.” They confirmed that Saint died of natural causes. She was 102.

Born in Newark, New Jersey, on the fourth of July, Eva Marie Saint was a stage actress for the early part of her career but made her film debut in the 1954 classic On the Waterfront, starring opposite Marlon Brando in Elia Kazan’s feature film that not only became a box office hit for the time but a major awards player. On the Waterfront earned twelve Academy Award nominations and won eight, including Best Supporting Actress for Eva Marie Saint. Her work in that film got her Hollywood career started, with Saint going on to star in other classics like John Frankenheimer’s All Fall Down , Otto Preminger’s epic Exodus, and Alfred Hitchcock’s North by Northwest .

Eva Marie Saint Dies at 102

Though her Hollywood career in the ’50s and ’60s is what became her trademark, for younger fans who like specific shows, Eva Marie Saint may be well known for two other distinct roles. Back in 2005, Saint took on the role of Martha Kent for Bryan Singer’s film Superman Returns , taking over the role from another fellow Hollywood golden age actress, Phyllis Thaxter. Ironically, the film “reunited” her with Marlon Brando, who appeared in the film as Jor-El from the original Superman via archival footage.

In an interview with The Today Show back in 2006, she revealed that she was excited to take on the part, but added: Then I was really excited when my three grandchildren said, ‘Cool,’ and they were so impressed.”

In addition to Superman Returns , Eva Marie Saint dipped her toes into the world of Avatar: The Last Airbender , taking on the voice role of Katara for the sequel series The Legend of Korra . Though she only appears in a handful of episodes, this version of the character proved to be a fan favorite as she was aged up decades from how fans knew her, showing a mature and wise character that survived the events of the original series. Speaking with The AV Club back in 2012, Saint revealed that she wanted to get into voice acting later in her career, specifically after watching Up with Ed Asner in the lead role.

In addition to all her work on the stage and the big screen, Eva Marie Saint could be seen on television for years as well, appearing in a slew of playhouse-style TV shows that were a staple of ’50s television. She would go on to appear in episodes of Frasier and Moonlighting, and even win an Emmy for the 1990 miniseries People Like Us. With a career as robust as hers was, Saint was one of the few performers to have two different stars on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, one for film and one for television.

Our thoughts go out to her family during this time.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 2 Preview and Synopsis Revealed
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 2 (Episode 172 overall) ahead of its October 10 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The official Episode 2 synopsis:

Against the demon that suddenly appeared in the Spade Kingdom through Morris’s actions, Mereoleona displays an overwhelming amount of magical power. At the same time, the Magic Knights who have infiltrated Spade Castle split into three groups and challenge their respective rivals, the Dark Triad. Charlotte faces Vanica, host of the devil Megicula, the source of her curse, while Yuno confronts Zenon, who abducted Vangeance right before his eyes. Meanwhile, Jack and Nacht, though struggling, are managing to fight on equal terms with Dante, who wields the strongest Body Magic. There should still be plenty of time before the gates of the underworld open. Just when Nacht thinks so, the one who appears before him is…!!

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, New Character Trailer and Visual Revealed
content:
KAGURABACHI anime has cast Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, introducing the character with a new visual and dedicated trailer. Nakamura’s casting joins the previously announced main cast ahead of the anime’s April 2027 premiere.

Studio Cypic is in charge of the animation production, with Tetsuya Takeuchi as the director. Takeuchi is famously known for the Rock Lee vs Gaara fight in Naruto. We previously also had the chance to interview CyberAgent’s Takahiro Yamauchi , who talked about the company and its goal of creating “ high-quality Japanese animation works that can be accepted globally .”

The main staff for the anime includes:

• Director: Tetsuya Takeuchi

• Character Design: Keigo Sasaki

• Production: Cypic

Previously, the anime revealed the following voice cast:

• Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira

• Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba

• Miku Ito as Hinao

• Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi

Azami is a sorcerer affiliated with the Kamunabi and one of the few people aware of Chihiro’s existence, which had been kept secret. He is described as one of the organization’s strongest members, possessing extraordinary physical strength capable of overwhelming opponents with devastating blows.

Nakamura shared the following full comments about joining the series:

“Although there are still relatively few characters, I paid close attention to how he balances with the others. This should really pay off when a lot more characters start appearing later on…! I approached the role viewing him as someone who is serious, yet carries a bit of a dry demeanor.”

On being cast and his impressions of the anime, he said:

“I read the manga when I auditioned for the role, and I felt like it really embodied the recent ‘spirit of Jump.’ I couldn’t wait to see what would happen next, so I ended up reading every volume that had been released! I’m incredibly excited to see all those memorable scenes brought to life in the anime.”

Nakamura also commented on the original manga:

“Although it starts off with a dark atmosphere, the protagonist’s convictions and goals are clearly defined, making it really fun to read. The action may be what catches people’s attention first, but the worldbuilding, artistic sensibility, and unfolding story are equally captivating.”

On Azami’s appeal, he added:

“He strikes me as a realist who serves as a contrast to the romanticist Shiba. He’s compassionate, yet there’s something interesting about how he stays slightly detached. I think he’s a character whose appeal will become increasingly apparent as the story progresses.”

Asked to describe the series in one phrase, Nakamura answered:

“Incandescent!”

Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba
Miku Ito as Hinao
Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi

Azami is a sorcerer affiliated with the Kamunabi and one of the few people aware of Chihiro’s existence, which had been kept secret. He is described as one of the organization’s strongest members, possessing extraordinary physical strength capable of overwhelming opponents with devastating blows.
Nakamura shared the following full comments about joining the series:

“Although there are still relatively few characters, I paid close attention to how he balances with the others. This should really pay off when a lot more characters start appearing later on…! I approached the role viewing him as someone who is serious, yet carries a bit of a dry demeanor.”
On being cast and his impressions of the anime, he said:

“I read the manga when I auditioned for the role, and I felt like it really embodied the recent ‘spirit of Jump.’ I couldn’t wait to see what would happen next, so I ended up reading every volume that had been released! I’m incredibly excited to see all those memorable scenes brought to life in the anime.”
Nakamura also commented on the original manga:

“Although it starts off with a dark atmosphere, the protagonist’s convictions and goals are clearly defined, making it really fun to read. The action may be what catches people’s attention first, but the worldbuilding, artistic sensibility, and unfolding story are equally captivating.”
On Azami’s appeal, he added:

“He strikes me as a realist who serves as a contrast to the romanticist Shiba. He’s compassionate, yet there’s something interesting about how he stays slightly detached. I think he’s a character whose appeal will become increasingly apparent as the story progresses.”

title: Exclusive: Viz Hosts Signing Tour for GalaXic Baseball League Comic Artist Acky Bright
content:
Viz Media announced on Wednesday a signing tour across the United States for the GalaXic Baseball League comic series — Viz's collaboration with MLB Players, Inc., OneTeam Partners, and the BW NYC Studios of Japanese artist Acky Bright. The tour will start on October 13, the release date of the comic's first volume. The ticketed signing events will feature artist Acky Bright at Kinokuniya bookstores in New York, Chicago, Seattle, San Francisco, and Los Angeles. Attendees will also receive a special poster of the comic series.

Detailed schedules of the event are as follows:

• New York: October 13 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• Chicago: October 14 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• Seattle: October 16 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

• San Francisco: October 17 - 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.

• Los Angeles (Little Tokyo): October 18 - 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m.

• Los Angeles (Santa Anita): October 18 - 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m.

The GalaXic Baseball League series launched exclusively on the Viz Manga app on July 2.

Viz describes the comic's story:

In the distant future, baseball has rocketed into the cosmos. What was once America's pastime is now a high-stakes interplanetary competition in which teams from every corner of the universe battle for glory. Amid a sinister plot to wreak havoc on the galaxy, legendary baseball players team up with two unlikely heroes in their quest to save Earth – and the heart and soul of baseball.

Viz credits Acky Bright with the story for what it describes as the first such IP that includes active baseball players. The artist cites the 2023 World Baseball Classic final as the inspiration for the project. The series features baseball stars Shohei Ohtani (Los Angeles Dodgers), Yoshinobu Yamamoto (Los Angeles Dodgers), Aaron Judge (New York Yankees), Fernando Tatis Jr. (San Diego Padres), Jazz Chisholm Jr. (New York Yankees), Kyle Schwarber (Philadelphia Phillies), Paul Skenes (Pittsburgh Pirates), and more.

Acky Bright is a Japanese visual artist who has worked on projects for DC Comics and Marvel from his studios, including one in New York. He founded the design studio Brightworks in 2002. He was one among six artists chosen by Museum of Modern Art curator Paola Antonelli to demonstrate Japanese art to travelers to Japan. The Narita and Haneda Airports installed his manga-style video starting from February 2021. Acky Bright has designed merchandise for Hasbro 's Transformers franchise . He has collaborated with BMW of Germany on the title Heroes of Rivalry featuring e-sports teams Cloud 9, FNATIC, FunPlus Phoenix, G2 Esports, T1, and OG Esports. More recently, Acky Bright drew the illustrations for a limited-time campaign for WcDonald's.

MLB Players is the business arm of the Major League Baseball Players Association, which represents all professional baseball players of the 30 Major League Baseball teams in collective bargaining and licensing. OneTeam Partners is a joint venture of the NFL Players Association, MLB Players Association, Women's National Basketball Players Association, MLS Players Association, and U.S. Women's National Team Players Association for sports licensing, marketing, sponsorship, and media.

title: Walking Home with You Anime Unveils April 2027 TV Debut
content:
The official website for the anime of Mai Matsuda 's Walking Home with You ( Hōkago Kitaku Biyori ) manga opened on Wednesday and confirmed the anime's television format. The website also unveiled the anime's teaser visual and April 2027 premiere on the NTV channel.

The tagline on the visual above reads, "The requirement for joining the club is walking home with me."

Matsuda also drew a commemorative illustration:

Digital manga publisher Omoi licensed the manga and describes the story:

Shun was the star of his middle school's soccer team, until an injury forced him to give up on his dream. Now in high school, he's adrift, with no real interests or passions … until he meets his oddball upperclassman Naoki. She ropes him into joining her unofficial “Hyper-Epic Heading Home Club,” a club with only one member dedicated to turning every walk home into an adventure. As Shun follows Naoki through her flights of fancy in search of elaborate detours, secret treasures, and anything else that catches her attention, can the Heading Home Club bring color back to his drab everyday life?

The manga's anime adaptation was first announced in March 2025.

Matsuda launched the manga in Futabasha 's Manga Action magazine in August 2023. Futabasha will publish the seventh volume on Thursday.

Matsuda launched the Hikaru in the Light! manga in Manga Action in May 2021, and ended it in August 2022. Futabasha published four compiled book volumes for the manga. Omoi (then Azuki ) licensed the manga, and released all four volumes in English.

title: Code Geass: Lost Stories Game to End Service on December 7
content:
The official website for the Code Geass : Lost Stories social game announced on Wednesday that the game will end service on December 7. Sales of the in-game Sakuradite currency, Lost Stories Pass, and Starter Pack has also ended on Wednesday.

The game launched for smartphones as well as on PC via the DMM Game Player in May 2022. The game is free to play, with optional in-game purchases available. Rock band FLOW performed the game's original theme song "Pendulum."

The game's English version launched for iOS and Android in September 2023 and ended service in August 2024.

The action role-playing game had been originally slated to launch in winter 2018 as a PC browser game, but was then listed with no release window. DMM Games then announced in November 2021 that it was restarting the game's development process with f4samurai as the developers.

Game developer JORO launched the separate Code Geass Knightmare Survivor game for iOS and Android on September 15. The "survivor action" game is free to play, with optional in-game purchases.

The Code Geass franchise is celebrating its 20th anniversary this year and onward with several projects, including a new anime titled Code Geass Hoshi Oi no Aspal ( Code Geass : Aspal the Star Chaser), a new musical stage play , and an exhibition.
